turns.question: Which country had the lowest average daily order revenue from 17 August to 2 October 2026, counting days with no orders from that country as zero and excluding cancelled orders, and what was that average?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no average-daily-revenue metric (and no zero-filling of days without orders), so I cannot give that average; the closest metric is Revenue (EUR), which excludes cancelled orders, and over 17 August to 2 October 2026 it was lowest for US at 1498.25 EUR (FR 1830.79, GB 3663.30, NL 4016.25, TR 4180.25, DE 4317.75). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
